Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff
Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff

Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. Gay Week in Review, with Andy Humm, Joyce Hunter, Darrell Yates Rist, and Evan Wolfson 2. Short news bits 3. Discussion of ex-gay man with AIDS who wants to be married in a Catholic church and discrimination against gay people and persons with AIDS COMMERCIAL: "First Hand" gay magazine 4. Discussion of the "Baby M" surrogate case and its possible impact on the gay community 5. UCLA poll finds 52% of national graduating college students support laws prohibiting homosexual behavior COMMERCIAL: GCN's "Year in Review" VHS tape 6. Andy Humm on the rates of unprotected sex among teenagers 7. News Briefs, three of anti-gay Patt Robinson's tax-exempt groups audited by IRS 8. London, Anglican churchmen advised to work out individual issues with homosexuality before attending at the bedside of a gay person dying of AIDS 9. Philadelphia, Colin Cook resigns from Quest ex-gay Learning center for engaging in sexual activities with students 10. East Lansing, Michigan, agrees to strengthen anti-discrimination protection for gays and other minorities 11. Oregon, gay inmates in prison allowed to kiss and hold hands during visits 12. Sports Report 13. Feature story on Gay Cable Network by Japanese program "New Yorking," with behind-the-scenes footage of GCN 14. Closing credits
The Right Stuff: 1. This Week in Gay History, with Jeff Bixby COMMERCIAL: "Manscape" gay magazine 2. Moments of Meditation, satirical segment with Ernest T. Lee COMMERCIAL: The Monster 3. Media Watch with Brandon Judell, announcement of "La Cage aux Folles" closing in London 4. Interview with members of GLAAD, writers Marcia Pally and James Saslow, discussion of the media's coverage of homosexuality COMMERCIAL: Zamir's Furs 5. Show Bits with George Trahanis, review of off-Broadway play, "Jerker" COMMERCIAL: A Different Light bookstore 6. Olivia Negron interviews Robert Drucker, banker at the Actor's Federal Credit Union 7. Closing credits
